segments.an11.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.an11.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena mahānāmo sakko gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
segments.an11.12:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti –
segments.an11.12:2.4: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an11.12:2.8: Tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabban”ti?
segments.an11.12:3.2: Etaṃ kho, mahānāma, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha –
segments.an11.12:3.3: ‘tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabban’ti?
segments.an11.12:3.4: Saddho kho, mahānāma, ārādhako hoti, no assaddho;
segments.an11.12:3.9: Imesu kho tvaṃ, mahānāma, pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttari bhāveyyāsi.
segments.an11.12:4.2: ‘itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an11.12:4.3: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an11.12:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.
segments.an11.12:4.5: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an11.12:4.6: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an11.12:4.7: Imaṃ kho tvaṃ, mahānāma, buddhānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi, nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi, sayānopi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsi.
segments.an11.12:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ tvaṃ, mahānāma, dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi … pe …
segments.an11.12:5.6: ‘santi devā cātumahārājikā … pe … santi devā tatuttari.
segments.an11.12:5.7: Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
segments.an11.12:5.11: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī’ti.
segments.an11.12:5.12: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an11.12:5.13: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha.
segments.an11.12:5.14: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an11.12:5.15: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an11.12:5.16: Imaṃ kho tvaṃ, mahānāma, devatānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi, nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi, sayānopi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsī”ti.

lines: 11-12. Dutiyassa paṭhame nānāvihārehi viharatanti gihīnaṃ nibaddho eko vihāro nāma natthi, tasmā amhākaṃ anibaddhavihārena viharantānaṃ kena vihārena katarena nibaddhavihārena vihātabbanti pucchati.
Dhammasotasamāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāvetīti dhammasotasamāpanno hutvā buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti.
Ko pana devānaṃ āhāro, kā āhāravelāti?
Sā heṭṭhimehi heṭṭhimehi uparimānaṃ uparimānaṃ paṇītatamā hoti, taṃ yathāsakaṃ divasavaseneva divase divase bhuñjanti.
Keci pana “biḷārapadappamāṇaṃ sudhāhāraṃ bhuñjanti, so jivhāya ṭhapitamatto yāva kesagganakhaggā kāyaṃ pharati, tesaṃyeva divasavasena satta divase yāpanasamattho hotī”ti vadanti.
Aṭṭhannañhi samāpattīnaṃ samāpajjanassa samayopi atthi tassa asamayopi, maggavimokkhena pana vimuccanassa samayo vā asamayo vā natthi.
Yassa saddhā balavatī, vipassanā ca āraddhā, tassa gacchantassa tiṭṭhantassa nisīdantassa nipajjantassa khādantassa bhuñjantassa ca maggaphalappaṭivedho nāma na hotīti na vattabbaṃ.
Iti maggavimokkhena vimuccantassa samayo vā asamayo vā natthīti maggavimokkho asamayavimutti nāma.
